record.name: YouSquared - AI Call Secretary
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turn missed calls into qualified leads.

YouSquared is your 24/7 AI Call Secretary and virtual receptionist. Our AI assistant answers when you're busy, intelligently screens every caller, speaks naturally with empathy, and shows you a detailed summary within seconds—so you never miss important calls and can prioritize who to call back first.

No subscription required, get started with YouSquared FREE.

**********

Key Features

AI MISSED CALL HANDLING
Can't pick up? Your AI answers for you with empathy, flags urgent ones to you, and captures the rest for later.

LEAD QUALIFICATION
Every caller is automatically screened, tagged, and labeled - so you know who's a real lead and who's not.

CALL TRANSFER TO YOU
When a call matters, your AI puts the caller through to you live.

CALL SUMMARIES
You'll get summaries of every call within seconds - perfect for quick scans.

SPAM FILTERING
AI-powered spam detection will help keep distractions out of your way.

CALENDAR ACCESS
Calendar integration lets qualified callers book open slots without back-and-forth.

NEW PHONE NUMBER
Keep your existing number and get a new second phone number that goes directly to your AI and that you can share publicly with everyone.

TEXTING
Your AI can instantly text the caller links (for example to your website) while still on the call.

CONTACT MANAGEMENT
Let your AI manage and update your contacts. The more they call, the better your AI becomes at interacting with them.

AI CHECK-INS
Talk directly to your AI to give instructions on contacts, check in on important things or get their opinion.

AI CUSTOMIZATION
Pick its name, gender, voice, tone and give it any instructions you want. You can even clone your voice. Decide to activate it only for a subset of your contacts.

MULTILINGUAL
Your AI can speak English, Spanish, French, Russian, Portuguese, German, Hindi, Japanese and more.

**********

For Businesses

Personal plans answer one call at a time and transfer calls to you. A YouSquared Business account turns your AI into a receptionist for your whole company:

• Up to 3 calls at a time
• Transfers to your team, hunt groups, contacts or any number
• Business hours, closed days, and your products & services
• Document signing: your AI guides callers through consent or service forms, live during the call
• Outbound campaigns and analytics
• Multiple AI lines and industry templates
• HIPAA & BAA

Ask us about a Business account from the app.

**********

Who is YouSquared For?
Healthcare professionals • Legal professionals • Real-estate agents • Contractors • Consultants • Anyone who can't risk a missed call

**********

Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://strange-attractor.com/u-squared/terms/

record.name: Secret AI: Local AI Chat
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Experience private offline AI chat with custom characters and no internet connection required. Secret AI is a secure local LLM chatbot and local AI assistant that runs entirely on your device - your conversations and custom characters stay 100% private with zero data collection, no servers, no account required, no tracking, and completely anonymous.

Perfect for users seeking:
- Private AI assistant without data tracking
- Offline AI chatbot works even in airplane mode
- Local AI processing for sensitive information
- Character AI with personalized settings
- Tool calling and MCP server support
- Custom Skills in the portable SKILL.md format
- Advanced AI engines with GGUF (llama.cpp), MNN, and MLX support
- Custom AI integration with self-hosted LLM APIs
- Voice AI control through Siri shortcuts
- On-Device AI chat without cloud dependencies
- Anonymous AI usage without registration
- Secure AI for business and personal use

What Makes Secret AI Your Trusted Private AI Assistant and Offline LLM Chatbot:

[True Privacy & Security - Local AI Processing]
All conversations and image analysis happen directly on your device using local LLM models and offline AI technology. Works without internet connection - perfect for airplane mode, underground areas, or locations without WiFi. Your private data never uploads to external servers, cloud services, or third-party AI providers.

[Custom AI Characters - Personalized Chat Experience]
Create and interact with completely custom AI companions tailored exactly to your preferences. Personalize every detail of your experience: design unique avatars, set custom background images, choose specific names, and even style chat bubbles and input boxes for a truly immersive chat environment. Prompts use the same {{user}} and {{char}} macros as character cards elsewhere.

[Tools, Skills & MCP - AI That Gets Things Done]
Your local AI model can use tools. Connect an MCP server, or write your own Skills as portable SKILL.md files. Every tool call opens up in the chat to show what went in and what came back. Tools stay off until you switch them on, and you approve each one the first time it runs.

[Siri Shortcuts Integration - Voice AI Assistant]
Use Siri to chat with AI without touching your phone! Set up shortcuts to ask questions or analyze images just by talking to Siri.

[Powerful Local LLM Performance - Offline AI Engine]
Optimized AI engines support both CPU and GPU acceleration with popular model formats including GGUF, MNN, and MLX. Choose from various offline AI models based on your device capabilities for optimal local LLM performance.

[High-Quality AI Models - Local LLM Library]
Access leading open-source models like Qwen3.5 VL, Gemma 4, LFM2.5 VL, MiniCPM 5, DeepSeek R1 0528, gpt-oss, Llama 4, Phi 4, Mistral, and other advanced local AI models - download directly from Hugging Face for enhanced offline AI chat experiences.

[API Integration Options - Custom AI Backend]
Connect to your self-hosted LLM API service, Ollama, or local LLM servers within your network for enhanced AI capabilities while maintaining complete privacy.

[Private Image Analysis - Offline Vision AI]
Process and analyze images completely on-device with no external transfers or cloud processing. Your photos remain 100% private and secure with local AI vision capabilities.

[Anonymous Usage - No Registration Required]
Use Secret AI completely anonymously with no account creation, email verification, or personal information required.

**Some premium features (such as GPU acceleration, unlimited chat sessions, MNN models, and advanced image analysis) require a one-time purchase or subscription. Basic offline AI features are available for free.**

AI power belongs in your hands, not in someone's cloud. Secret AI keeps your secrets secret.

Terms of Use
https://secretai.io/legal/terms

Privacy Policy
https://secretai.io/legal/privacy

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Private by default. Frontier when you want it.

Solair puts every kind of AI in your pocket, and keeps it private. Run powerful models fully on-device with no account and no internet, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and more when you want the frontier. Create images along the way, and keep every one in a gallery of your own.

RUN AI ON YOUR DEVICE
• 100% on-device models, no account, no sign-up, no tracking. Once a model downloads, everything works offline.
• Your conversations, photos, health data, and documents are processed locally and never leave your device.
• Auto Mode picks the right model for each message: Fast for quick questions, Smart for deep reasoning, Vision for photos and documents.
• A duress code and fully local processing mean no one can read your data, not even us.

BRING YOUR FAVORITE AI
• Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Kimi, DeepSeek, Mistral, and more in one tap, just paste your API key.
• Send photos, PDFs, and videos, watch reasoning models think, and generate images where supported.
• Real web research: cloud models search the web themselves and show every source they read.
• With your permission, they can read your health, calendar, and weather, and chart it for you.
• Tokens, estimated spend, and voice minutes tracked per provider.
• Your memory and past chats stay on your device unless you choose to share them.

CREATE IMAGES, AND KEEP THEM ALL
• Generate images right in your conversation. Choose the quality, the shape, and how many, and see what each option costs before you create.
• Every image you make lands in a gallery of your own: folders you name, favorites, and full-screen browsing.
• Pinch to zoom, swipe to move through them, and see them in real HDR that glows on your display.
• Jump from any image straight back to the conversation that created it.

TALK TO IT
• Live voice conversations with ChatGPT and Grok, interrupt anytime, and the whole talk lands in your chat as a transcript.
• Every other provider gets a voice on-device, only text ever leaves your phone, never audio, and live transcription types your words as you speak.

MORE TO LOVE
• Build your own apps (beta): describe one in a sentence and Solair makes a real, working app that runs offline. Four finished apps are included.
• Scheduled tasks: give Solair a job and a time, and the answer arrives as a notification, all on your device.
• Personas: chat with friends, historical figures, or build your own.
• Personal memory that learns your preferences, and document analysis with instant summaries.
• Health intelligence, ask about steps, sleep, and workouts from Apple Health, all on-device. Informational only, not medical advice.
• Connect to your own server (Ollama and more) securely over Tailscale.
• A beautiful Liquid Glass interface for iOS 26, with an engine switcher, sidebar search, and customizable themes.
• Models included: Qwen3 & 3.5, Llama 3.2, Mistral, Gemma 3, plus coding, lightweight, and vision models like Qwen VL and LFM2.5.

WHY SOLAIR
Most AI apps send everything to the cloud. Solair runs on your device first, so your private data stays private, and reaches for the cloud only when you choose.

REQUIREMENTS
• iPhone A14 or newer, iPad A12 or newer, Mac with Apple Silicon. iOS 26 or later. 500MB to 5GB per on-device model.

Solair is free with no ads. Optional tips support development but never lock features.

Verify your AI Answers. Asks The Top AI Models. Get One Better Answer.

Stop switching between AI apps hoping one gets it right. AllChat asks the top leading AI models your question at the same time, then combines all their answers into one ultimate response. It's not picking a model. It's using all of them.

CONSENSUS MODE
Most AI apps give you one model's opinion. AllChat gives you all of them. Your message is sent to multiple AI models simultaneously. Their responses are analyzed and synthesized into a single answer that is more accurate, more balanced, and more reliable than any one model alone. Think of it as a panel of AI experts who debate and agree on the best answer, instantly.

See exactly how AllChat arrived at your answer. The transparency panel shows which models agreed, where they differed, and how the final response was built.

SMART ROUTING
Not sure which model to use? Let AllChat decide. Smart Routing analyzes your question and automatically picks the best model for the job: the strongest coding model for programming, the sharpest reasoning model for math, the most creative model for writing. You get the right AI every time without thinking about it.

Smart Routing also powers Consensus Mode. It hand-picks the right lineup of models for your specific question, so the panel debating your answer is always the best one for the job. Smarter routing means smarter consensus.

SMART ALERTS
Get custom alerts the moment something matters to you. Set up notifications for topics, prices, news, or anything you want AllChat to keep an eye on. AllChat checks in the background and pings you when there's something worth knowing.

SWITCHING FROM CHATGPT?
Bring your memory with you. AllChat can import your ChatGPT conversations and memory so you don't have to start over. Your new AI already knows you.

PICK ANY MODEL
Don't need consensus? Switch to any individual model with a tap. Use the best coding model for programming, the best creative model for writing, or let Smart Routing pick for you.

Consensus Mode: multiple models, one best answer

ChatGPT memory import: switch without losing context

Web search: real-time answers grounded in live results
On-device models: private, offline, no data leaves your phone
Memory: AllChat remembers your preferences across conversations
Transparency panel: see how your answer was built

Your conversations are yours. AllChat offers on-device models for fully offline use, encrypted storage, and you control what data is shared. No ads. No tracking.
